k.summary: Agent K: free-kick choreography and the kick clock. FREE KICKS now have no lineup and no walking: every taker (human and AI) is placed straight at the run-up start (the AI walk-in is off for that format), and the bodies neither taking nor keeping stand scattered behind him - the taker's own side 3-8 m behind the ball in a seeded loose fan either side of the run-up line, the opposing side's non-keeping bodies 10-14 m back on the taker's left, marks recomputed per (pair, kicker) from a fork of the round's Spots stream (CupSpots.FreeKickMarks), with clearance from each other, the run-up start and the referee; bodies are live and idle (balance on, locomotion off, a seeded watching stand, heads on the ball, the lineup look cone for a human). The pre-round idle layout puts both sides in the near band anchored at the box front so the captains reach the coin toss inside the ceremony's timeout, and from the Intro on the layout is the first kick's (twins included). A missed/saved free kick is a CupTuning.FreeKickMissBeat (3 s) dejection on the shooter where he stands (seeded variant from the round's Dejection stream, CupChoreo.OnMissDeject) with the taker stood down first, then the cut - no walk-back; a goal frees the WHOLE scoring side's humans for the scored window (locomotion + wheel, a freed non-keeping keeper body now ticks, the skip stays the scorer's) while the AI side stays put; the decisive kick keeps the win/lose beats. Kick clock: zeroed the instant the Armed->Live edge fires (SetKickClock(0) at Live entry) so neither the HUD nor the wire state can show a ring on a struck ball; the human input path was traced end to end (SetPieceTaker.Begin/TickCharging/TickRunup/LaunchSetPiece, BallController.ResetTo/LaunchSetPiece velocity write, CupLocalInput's held latch, the ReplaySystem kinematic restore, the wall/run-up/aim geometry) and two real causes fixed: the lineup marks sat inside the free-kick band (a scattered body no longer can stand on the spot or the run-up path and pin or physically strike the dead ball under SetPieceShot), and SetPieceTaker.Begin's stale-actuation guard swallowed a Space already held at the whistle (the cup's settle + raise beat invites exactly that hold; the meter never moved and the release committed nothing, leaving the clock to the weak auto-shot) - Begin is now handed a one-call mask (ChargeGate) so an anticipating hold charges from the whistle. Goal determination keeps the physics-rate line-crossing latch AND the per-frame BallFullyInGoal box test; the rest/6 s verdicts no longer fire on a ball still bound for the goal (not fully over the line and moving toward it above CupTuning.LiveApproachSpeed), only once it has clearly stopped (BallController kills a roll below BallRollStop), crossed or left play, under a 20 s hard cap. Compile clean, all files CRLF, no editor / MCP / graphify used.

DESK CHECK - one Solo free-kick round, R32, human = side A (slot 0, shooter body v0 + keeper twin v8), AI = side B (shooter v9, keeper v10), referee v11, coin -> A kicks first. Pair-0 spot say (-4, 0.22, -3) (20 m out); dir to goal = (0.196, 0, 0.981), right = (0.981, 0, -0.196).
CONFIGURE (Idle): idle marks anchored at the box front on the spot's axis: human group (shooter v0) 3-8 m behind the anchor on the LEFT, AI group (shooter v9 + keeper v10) on the RIGHT; keeper twin v8 parked hidden at HideSpot(0) = (-4.5, 0, 26); ball on the spot; wall 4 men at WallCenter = (-2.2, 0, 5.98); referee at RefereeMark = (-1.06, 0, -3.59) facing the run-up start. Coin toss walks the captains (v0 at x=-1.2; Solo shows the human only) at most ~12 m.
INTRO (3 s card): ParkAllAtMarks with the FIRST KICK's layout (kicker A): v0 at RunUpStart = (-4.59, 0, -5.94) facing the goal, v8 parked, v9 (opp, not keeping) in the far band e.g. depth 12 / lateral 6 left -> about (-12.2, 0, -13.6) facing the goal +-12 deg, v10 on KeeperStart (0, 0, 16.4) facing -Z; camera released.
KICK 1 - HUMAN GOAL: Placing (0.45 s; AssignFreeKickMarks(pair 0, A) gives the same marks; no walk-in; Choreo.OnPlacing -> EnterWatch(v9) hands-on-hips / behind-back / one-hand variant, locomotion off, head on the ball; Rig.TakerView = GameCamera.Follow) -> WhistleRaise (0.4 s, PlayWhistle at its end) -> Armed (clock 12 s; ArmTaker: ChargeGate masks Space for the Begin call so a Space already held charges from the whistle; look-ray aim from GameCam.Yaw/Pitch off THIS spot; hold -> meter, release -> 3 m run-up to the spot -> Struck -> Ball.ResetTo(spot) + LaunchSetPiece writes Rb.linearVelocity -> Speed > 2.5 in the same TickArmed -> SetPhase(Live): SetKickClock(0), SaveWatch armed, wall hops) -> Live (FixedUpdate sweep latches the line crossing inside the frame OR the per-frame box test -> Verdict(Goal)) -> Verdict (1.3 s, ring frozen) -> Scored (5 s: v0 Freed, CanLocalSkip, CamHold(v0); teamWindow has no other human in Solo; AI v9 stays in his watch stand) -> replay (3 s @0.45, click 1/1) -> Placing kick 2.
KICK 2 - AI MISS (pair 0, kicker B, same spot): marks recomputed: v9 taker -> RunUpStart, v8 keeper twin unparked on KeeperStart facing -Z (InputLocked false, HoldLine until Live), v0 shooter twin parked, v10 (AI keeper, not keeping) in the OWN band e.g. depth 5 / lateral 3 right -> about (-2.0, 0, -8.5); Choreo.EnterWatch(v10); KeeperView for the human -> WhistleRaise -> Armed (bot: delay 0.8-1.6 s, JumpHeld, release at ~TakerPower(R32) 0.61) -> Live -> ball wide: BallOutOfPlay (behindGoal) -> Verdict(Miss) -> 1.3 s -> WalkBack phase = miss beat: taker Reset (no settle fighting the pose), Choreo.OnMissDeject(v9) rolls 0..2 -> DejectKnees / DejectHips / DejectFall where he planted beside the ball; human keeper holds his own camera -> 3 s (FreeKickMissBeat) -> no replay (miss) -> Placing kick 3.
KICK 3 - HUMAN MISS (pair 1: NEW spot drawn lazily, wall rebuilt on its line, marks recomputed for kicker A): v0 at the new RunUpStart, v8 parked, v9 far band left, v10 keeping; Armed -> release -> strike -> Live -> ball rolls slowly toward the line: `approaching` (not fully over, vz > 0.15) holds off the rest/6 s verdicts until the roll dies (BallRollStop) or it crosses/leaves -> stops short -> Verdict(Miss) -> WalkBack = dejection on v0 where he stands, his Follow camera holds on him (the pelvis drops with DejectKnees/DejectFall) -> 3 s -> Placing kick 4.
KICK 4 - AI GOAL (pair 1, kicker B): v9 at the run-up, v8 on the line, v10 own band; bot strikes -> Live -> goal latch -> Verdict(Goal) -> Scored: v9 Freed (no Striker: Choreo.OnScored runs him 1.2 s toward his mark = the run-up start, then up to 2 seeded ScorerEmotes); the human keeper's camera turns to him (CamHold, existing behaviour) -> replay -> Placing kick 5.
DECISIVE KICK: Verdict -> Decided unchanged (winners Freed incl. a non-keeping keeper body now ticked in TickFreedBodies; losers deject in the scatter via OnLoseBeat; referee raise + PlayWhistleTriple) -> replay -> Over.
KICK CLOCK: decremented only while Armed (skeleton Update), the Live edge is checked AFTER TickTaker in the same frame (speed > 2.5 OR taker Struck OR ball 30 cm off the spot), and KickClockRemaining is zeroed at Live entry, so CupHud's ring condition (Phase == Armed && 0 < remaining <= 5) and a client's mirrored state can never show a ring after the strike.
k.notesForNextAgents:
1) FREE-KICK MARKS LIVE IN CupBody.LineupMark / LineupFacing (the doc comment in CupBodies.cs still says "position in its side's lineup" - not my file): in Free Kicks they are the body's mark FOR THE CURRENT KICK, rewritten by AssignFreeKickMarks at every Placing and at the Intro, and by AssignFreeKickIdleMarks at Configure. The taker's mark is the run-up start, the keeper's his line, hidden twins keep whatever they had. Anything that reads a lineup mark in Free Kicks (CupChoreo.OnScored's run direction, CupCameraRig.WalkBackView's slot) now gets the scatter mark. Penalties are untouched: PlanBodies' lineup marks stand for the whole round.
2) THE ROOT CAUSES BEHIND "my free kick did not launch": (a) CupSpots.LineupZ (box front + 1 m = 17.5 m from goal) sits INSIDE the 17-28 m free-kick band, so a lineup body could stand on the spot, the run-up path or the wall's line; a body touching the dead ball under BallController.SetPieceShot fires a full-power PHYSICAL strike from the contact point (or pins the ball), and the swept/moved tests then read a kick nobody took. The scatter removes every body from between the taker and the goal (only the wall and the keeper remain) with 1.2 m clearance from the run-up start. (b) SetPieceTaker.Begin latches _awaitingRelease when Space is DOWN at Begin: the cup's placement settle + whistle raise is a get-ready beat players hold Space through, so the first hold charged nothing and its release committed nothing. ArmTaker now wraps the human's input in ChargeGate with MaskHeld for the Begin call only. Do not remove either; if the editor pass still sees a swallowed release, the next suspects are GameInput's action map state and the CupLocalInput latch (which deliberately reports HELD through a gate - a release during the pause overlay lands when the gate lifts).
3) THE KICK CLOCK contract: decremented by the skeleton's Update only while Armed; TickArmed checks the Live edge AFTER TickTaker (the launch is inside it) with speed > 2.5 OR taker Struck OR ball 30 cm off the spot; Live entry zeroes it. CupHud's ring keys off Phase == Armed && 0 < remaining <= 5 and needs nothing else. A client HUD reads the mirrored KickClockRemaining, which now arrives as 0 from the Live state.
4) VERDICT RULE: never resolve a rest/time-out while `approaching`; the only ways out of Live are goal (latch / swept crossing / box), out of play (CupSpots.BallOutOfPlay incl. behindGoal), stopped (RestHold with the roll dead), the 6 s cap when NOT approaching, or LiveHardCap 20 s. A human keeper carrying the ball toward his own goal is the case that reaches the hard cap. KeeperHands' hold semantics (does a held ball carry linearVelocity?) were not inspected; a held ball reading speed 0 resolves as SAVED on the rest hold.
5) LOCOMOTION OFF in the scatter (EnterWatch) follows the owner's brief; the lineup (EnterLineup) keeps locomotion ON with zero input because a neighbour's arm could nudge a body off its mark. If the editor pass sees a scattered body drift or sway-walk on the slick feet with Breathe on, flip the one line in EnterWatch to LocomotionEnabled = true (the steer holds the mark) - nothing else depends on it.
6) THE SCATTER GEOMETRY vs THE FOLLOW CAMERA: the human taker's free-kick camera is GameCamera.Follow (~6 m behind the pelvis at the run-up start, i.e. ~9 m behind the ball, on the axis). Own-side bodies at depth 3-8 m are in front of / beside the camera; the lateral floor grows with depth (2.4 m at 3 m, ~4 m at 8 m) to keep them off the axis. Tune FreeKickTeamLateralMin/Max first if bodies crowd the frame edges. The opposing group is always on the taker's LEFT (the referee's mark is 3 m on his RIGHT); the own group's side is seeded per body.
7) COIN TOSS in Free Kicks: the idle layout is anchored at the box-front point of the pair-0 spot's axis (not the spot, which can be 28 m out) so a captain's jog to the ceremony mark stays inside CupCoinToss.ApproachTimeout (4.5 s at 3.2 m/s); the ball still sits on the real spot and is kept clear. CupCoinToss reads nothing from the marks.
8) DETERMINISM: scatter marks fork the round's Spots stream with salt 0x9000 + pair*2 + (kicker == B) (idle: 0x9000 + 0x0FFF), a family no CupSalts value and not the bot's 0x8000 block uses; Fork never advances the parent, so the lazy spot schedule is unchanged. Watch-pose variants and the miss-dejection variant are drawn from the round's Dejection stream in call order (EnterWatch draws one per watching body at every placement, OnMissDeject one per miss), which shifts OnRoundDecided's protagonist roll relative to the previous build - fine, it only has to agree across peers that simulate.
9) A freed non-keeping keeper body (Co-op team keeper when his side scores a free kick; the winning side's keeper in the beat) is now ticked in TickFreedBodies with InputLocked false and HoldLine false. His look yaw source is GameCam.KeeperLookYaw, stale in a rig-owned Hold view - same limitation the freed scorer has with GameCam.Yaw (C2's note).
10) RoundPhase.WalkBack is REUSED as the Free Kicks miss beat (the enum rides the wire in CupRoundState, not mine to extend); a client mirroring that phase in Free Kicks should expect a standing dejection, not a walk.
11) Not editor-verified (per the brief): the watch stands' look on live bodies, the fan's framing in the Follow camera, the Intro-layout twin swap in Free Kicks, and the ChargeGate mask against a real held key. First play-mode pass: one Solo free-kick round holding Space through the whistle (the meter must sweep from the whistle), one miss (dejection where he stands, cut at 3 s, no ring after the strike), one slow roll toward the line (no MISS before it stops or crosses).
openIssues: Not run in the Unity editor (another agent owns it): the scatter fan's framing in GameCamera.Follow, the three watch stands on live bodies with locomotion off (possible drift on the slick feet - see note 5), the free-kick Intro layout with the AI kicking first (keeper twin on the line under the card), and the ChargeGate mask against a real anticipating hold are desk-checked only.

A wall deflection that flies 3-8 m back into the taker's own scattered group can physically touch a body (the ball only ignores the taker and the referee, exactly as with the penalty lineup); under SetPieceShot a leg contact re-launches at full power. Rare; making the ball ignore every non-playing body per placement (IgnoreBody per body, ~15 IgnoreCollision calls each) is the fix if it shows.

KeeperHands' hold was not inspected: if a claimed ball carries the keeper's velocity, a human keeper walking toward his own goal with it counts as `approaching` and the attempt runs to the 20 s hard cap instead of the old 6 s (then SAVED, or GOAL if he carries it fully over the line - the same own-goal reading FreeKickGame has).

CupBodies.CupBody.LineupMark's doc comment ('position in its side's lineup') is now stale for Free Kicks (it is the per-kick scatter mark there); CupBodies.cs was outside my ownership so the comment was left, and the meaning is documented in CupRoundDriver.Scene.cs's header and AssignFreeKickMarks.
RoundPhase.WalkBack doubles as the Free Kicks miss beat (the enum is wire state in CupRoundState.cs, not mine to extend); a client-side reader that names phases would call it a walk-back.

CupHud.LocalFreed got a one-line seam edit (returns true on driver.LocalIsFreed) outside the listed ownership so freed free-kick teammates get the wheel; if the HUD owner prefers, the same line can move into their next pass.

The idle scatter's per-body facing jitter and the watch-pose variants consume the round's Dejection stream, so seeded dejection variants for a given round differ from the previous build's - deterministic, but not comparable to earlier screenshots.

g.notesForNextAgents:
HEAD TO HEAD AGENT: enter the podium exactly as Solo does - at the Final: RecordResult, EndRound (the podium spawns its OWN bodies from the bracket, the round's are gone), SimulateAiRounds, CupCareer.Won, SetPhase(Podium); in the Podium entry call TryBeginPodium() (fallback: PlayFanfare + SetPhase(Results)); close it with EndPodium() from your own CloseScreens (Solo's CloseSoloScreens does). No humans alive: SimulateRest to the end first (Bracket.Champion must be set; Begin falls back to LocalEntrant and refuses with -1). The podium's buttons already branch on Style / IsAuthority (host Play Again/Continue/End Match, client End Match + "waiting for the host"); Continue is ContinueFromResults (Podium -> Results, CupResultsUI.Summary). Human losers are every player with Active && Entrant >= 0 (a leaver shows as an AI body named "Alice (AI)" if he is among the beaten finalist/semi-finalists).

CO-OP AGENT: at Driver.Phase == Over of a won Final: RecordResult(CurrentRound, Driver.Line); RecordLocalRoundCareer; SimulateAiRounds; CupCareer.Won; SetPhase(TrophyLift); in the TrophyLift ENTRY call BeginTrophyLift() and DO NOT call EndRound before it - the lift runs on the round's bodies (EndRound now ends a live lift first, so a stray EndRound just cancels the cinematic). Its Continue ends the lift, ends the round and calls ContinueFromResults (-> Results: CupResultsUI.Champions); pass your own onContinue if you need a different hand-off. Lost Finals never see it. The lift is host/local simulated: on a Client authority it only shows the camera and the UI (no body moves) - the client's puppets must follow the host's snapshot through the whole 14 s + free window, so the net agent must keep streaming bodies (positions + emoteId/phase incl. the referee's Clap) while Driver.Phase == Over; the host's driver does not feed remote inputs at Over, so in the free window a remote human's Striker is ticked by the lift but reads a stale/empty NetInput unless HostTick's FeedRemoteInputs keeps running past Over.

NET AGENT: podium bodies: CupDirector.Podium.Bodies (winner first; CupBody.VirtualSlot = the slot for a human, AiBodyIdBase up for AI), WinnerEmoteId/WinnerEmotePhase for the snapshot, PlayWinnerEmote(e) for a remote champion's pick (only the curated page is accepted). Losers are static: nothing to sync. A client puppet posing the winner with DisplayEmote will drop the trophy arm during Wave/Salute/Point (DisplayEmote has no additive hold) - either pose the client's winner as a live body (as the podium builds it) or add the left-arm hold to the puppet path. Podium bodies are spawned identically on every peer from the bracket + players, so only the champion's emote needs the wire.

CUPTEXT: the two hint strings ("B emotes - drag to orbit - Esc", "WASD move - B emotes - drag to orbit") are consts on CupPodium / CupTrophyLift, not CupText (agent A's file was not mine to edit); move them if you want every string in one place.

CAMERA: CupCameraRig.Cinematic(shots, onDone) is generic - CupShot.Move / CupShot.Arc with a Func<Vector3> look-at, per-shot Cut/ease, FovEnd, and OnStart cues; the camera holds the last pose until the caller picks a view. PodiumOrbit(centre, startAngle, restart) restarts the orbit as a cut. PodiumFreeCursorDrag (default true) lets the LMB drag orbit with a FREE cursor - the podium and the lift's free window keep the cursor free for their buttons and wheel and re-free it after an unpause and after a wheel pick (CupEmoteWheel.SetOpen captures on close).

POSES: the winner's left arm is held at CupPodium.HoldUpperArmL/HoldForearmL in LateUpdate under every non-lift emote (Celebration.Update clears overrides then poses only its own bones; a LateUpdate write wins for the frame's joint targets - CupChoreo's trick). TrophyLift is authored to the DERIVED lateral rule (+Z on the left arm = inboard): 162 puts the hands 12 cm apart above the head; if a play-mode look shows the arms in a wide V, the older EmotePose convention holds after all - flip the sign of the 162/-162 pair and the hold's 165 together.

TEARDOWN: CupPodium frees the dais/trim meshes, stone + gold materials, its CupKitCache, the trophy (mesh via GeneratedMeshOwner), the confetti, un-ignores the ball and releases the rig; it also disables the losers' ActiveRagdoll components (kinematic puppets need no solver). The ball is parked at (-(FieldWidth/2 - 1.5), r, spot.z - 4) for the podium; the next round's driver re-places it.

v.summary: Built the Trickshot Cup menu vignette as Assets/Scripts/Play/MenuScenes/CupScene.cs (a DeadBallScene subclass, house style) and pointed MenuSceneStage.Create(TrickshotCup) at it. The player's own body (forced Human, roster look) takes a 2.6 m run-up and strikes a penalty from a 9 m spot; the ball is re-launched on the crosser's fire frame with a 0.44 s flight to a low corner (-2.9 m, 0.5 m at the line) so the real Goalkeeper AI (4-arg Init, outSign -1, HoldLine until the strike, stage ability 0.6) commits a flat LOW-band dive the right way and is beaten by about a metre; the ball crosses the line into an invisible catcher 0.7 m behind it (the 'net'), the taker turns toward the lens and plays the real Celebration.FistPump, then holds. A gold lathe-cup trophy with two torus handles (one mesh, one gold material) sits on a stone plinth in the near-left foreground. Freeze/Thaw/Reset follow the house rules (BecomeDisplayBody + ragdoll/HairSim/AnatomySim disabled via the base, Celebration component disabled while frozen, cancelled before any reset, crosser cosmetic pose restored), the camera is a FitCamera solve for PanelAspect, every material goes through M()/Own() and the trophy mesh is freed in Destroy. docs/compile-check.sh exit=0; zero warnings or errors in either file; both files CRLF.
v.verification:
1) `bash docs/compile-check.sh` from the repo root: `exit=0 out=/tmp/.../Trickshot.dll`, run after writing the file and again after the CRLF pass. 2) A second csc run through a response file with ALL diagnostics kept, grepped for `CupScene|MenuSceneStage`: no lines at all (zero errors, zero warnings in the two files). 3) CRLF verified byte-wise with Python: CupScene.cs 295 CRLF / 0 bare LF; MenuSceneStage.cs 362 / 0. 4) `git diff --stat` on MenuSceneStage.cs: 3 insertions (the Create case + its comment); every other modified file in `git status` is the other agents' pre-existing cup work. No Unity editor / MCP / graphify used, per the task rules, so the framing and the beat are desk-checked only.

TIMELINE (scaled seconds from hover = the whistle; the stage runs at timeScale 0.7, so multiply by 1.43 for real time): t=0 the taker stands on the run-up mark 2.6 m behind the spot (-0.9 m to the side), the keeper is set 0.08 m off his line with HoldLine, the ball is on the spot; t~0.55-0.65 the run-up (DeadBallScene Jog at 4.6 m/s) plants within 0.45 m of the ball, Crosser.ServeNow starts the 0.45 s KickSwing windup; t~1.05 STRIKE: Crosser.Launch fires (JustServed), the scene re-launches the ball the same frame with Ball.LaunchTo(aim, 0.44 s) and releases HoldLine; t~1.21 the keeper commits (0.163 s reaction at ability 0.6): LaunchBandDive(Low) toward -X; t~1.49 NET: the ball crosses the line at (-2.9, 0.50) and is caught 0.7 m behind it by the NetBackstop catcher; the taker's Crosser pose is switched off, his facing is turned to the camera and Celebration.FistPump (1.6 s) plays to t~3.09; Done at HoldSeconds 3.5. Beat to the net 1.5 s scaled (2.1 s real); whole vignette 3.5 s scaled (5 s real), in line with the other scenes' 3.4-3.6.

AIM VS THE DEAD BAND (Goalkeeper.DeadBand = KeeperStrafeSpeed 5.5 * lerp(0.45,2.0,0.6)=1.38 * StepRealised 0.55 * (tRem - 0.08), clamped 0.65..3.2; = 4.17 m/s of reach): spot to line 9.0 m in 0.44 s -> vz 20.5 m/s, vx -6.6, vy 4.95 (|v| ~22 m/s, apex 0.84 m at 0.25 s, 0.50 m at the line). Reaction lerp(0.55,0.05,sqrt(0.6)) = 0.163 s; at commit the ball is at z~3.3, tRem to his plane (z 8.92) = 0.274 s -> dead band 4.17 * 0.194 = 0.81 m; predicted offset 3.26 m (>> 0.81 -> dive); predictY 0.51 m (< AiKeeperLowBallHeight 1.0 -> low band); 3.26 > splay reach 1.6*1.06 = 1.70 and <= low-dive reach 4.5*1.06 = 4.77 -> LaunchBandDive(Low), full flat layout at 84 deg. Commit gate |predictX| <= GoalWidth/2 - 0.4 + 1.2 passes at EVERY legal GoalEditor width (min 0.6x -> 3.0 m), which is why the corner is 2.9 m and not the 3.3 m a regulation goal allows. Beaten: horizontal impulse capped at KeeperDiveHorizBase * lerp(1,1.1,0.6) = 3.79 m/s, turf friction over 0.27 s -> ~0.85 m of travel; the Dive pose's gloves sit in a bar at the shoulder line (0.38 m from the pelvis) + 0.35 m glove radius, the head at 0.89 m -> reach at ball height ~1.6 m, torso/head ~1.8 m, versus the ball's near edge crossing at 2.7 m: ~0.9 m clear; even an instant reaction (1.65 m of travel) still falls ~0.3 m short.
v.publicApi: namespace Trickshot. `public class CupScene : DeadBallScene` - no new public surface beyond the MenuScene contract: `Build()`, `Reset()`, `Freeze()`, `Thaw()`, `Tick(float dt)`, `Frame(out Vector3 camPos, out Vector3 lookAt, out float fov)`, `Destroy()`; protected overrides `HoldSeconds` (3.5), `Lofted` (false), `Aim`, `TickAfterStrike(float dt)`. Private tunables (consts): PenaltyDist 9.0, LineStandoff 0.08, CornerX 2.9, CornerY 0.5, FlightTime 0.44, NetDepth 0.7, CornerSide -1, CamDir (-0.52, 0.30, -0.80), TrophyAt (-4.0, 0, 1.6), PlinthW/H 0.5, KeeperTorso/KeeperLimb/Gold/Stone colours. `MenuSceneStage.Create(GameMode.TrickshotCup)` now returns `new CupScene()` (was the FreeKickScene placeholder).
v.notesForNextAgents: 1) The keeper is the REAL Goalkeeper brain; every number in the class summary was solved against Goalkeeper.Tick's gates (dead band, reaction clock, low/splay/low-dive reaches, the halfGoal+1.2 commit gate). Retune by changing FlightTime / CornerX / CornerY only after re-running that arithmetic; a slower ball (>~0.6 s) puts him inside his dead band and he steps and catches instead of diving. 2) The ball is re-launched on the frame Crosser.JustServed is true (TickAfterStrike): the Crosser's own driven default (CrossTimeDrive 0.95 * CrossChargeFlatMul 0.8 = 0.76 s) is deliberately overridden; keep that re-launch before any physics step (it is, the stage ticks in Update). 3) The FistPump only shows because Kicker.Cosmetic is set false at the net: Crosser.ApplyKickPose clears ALL pose overrides every tick and runs after Celebration.Update, so with it on the emote is wiped before FixedUpdate ever sees it. Reset puts Cosmetic back. 4) The dive-commit gate reads the MUTABLE SimConfig.GoalWidth (a practice GoalEditor can leave it at 0.6x): the scene compensates by aiming 2.9 m; the cleaner fix is adding GoalWidth/GoalHeight to MenuSceneStage.TakeGlobals/ReleaseGlobals (saved-when-set, restored-if-still-ours), which was outside this task's edit allowance - do that and the corner can go to 3.3 m. 5) Framing was solved on paper: camera at the -X side, elevated 17.5 deg, centre biased low and toward the taker so the run-up mark's feet clear the bottom edge; the keeper lands ~16 m from the lens (about 14% of the panel height). If he reads too small in the editor, the levers are PenaltyDist (compress further), the FitCamera extents in Frame, or fov. The ball goes to the -X (camera-side) corner on purpose: the +X corner projects onto the keeper's gloves from this angle and reads as a save. 6) Celebration on a live scene body: Cancel() before ResetTo (End() writes body velocities), disable the component while frozen; Play() snapshots UprightLock/Balance/Locomotion and End() restores them, so assert sane standing flags before Play. 7) The trophy is one MeshGen.Combine(lathe, torus, torus) mesh freed in Destroy() and one M() gold material; the plinth is a collider-less Make.Box with an M() stone material. Torus arcs start at local +Z; Euler(90,0,0) stands a ring up as (x,y,z)->(x,-z,y), leaving the gap centred 215 deg from +X, hence the -35 deg Z turn. 8) No audio in menu vignettes (none of the scenes play any); 'the whistle' is the hover.
openIssues: Not verified in the Unity editor (no MCP per the task rules): the FitCamera framing (keeper size at ~16 m, the run-up mark's feet at the bottom edge, the trophy at the near-left), the trophy's look, the yaw-servo turn toward the camera during the fist pump (if it reads as a spin, use Rag.SnapFacing instead), and the keeper's actual dive reach against the estimate. First play-mode pass: disable MenuUI, drive MenuSceneStage.SetHover(TrickshotCup) by reflection, capture at t~1.2 s (dive), t~1.5 s (net) and t~2.5 s (pump).

The corner is 2.9 m (not the 3.3 m a regulation goal allows) because Goalkeeper's commit gate reads the mutable SimConfig.GoalWidth that a practice goal editor can leave at 0.6x; MenuSceneStage does not pin GoalWidth/GoalHeight. Adding them to TakeGlobals/ReleaseGlobals (outside this task's allowed edit) would let the shot go wider.

The 'net' is the house-style invisible catcher 0.7 m behind the line (the design rules out goals/pitches in the panels), so the ball simply dies just past the keeper's gloves; there are no posts to reference the corner against.
The penalty spot is compressed to 9 m (like FreeKickScene's 6.2 m wall) so the keeper reads in a panel; the keeper logic is flight-time based so the numbers hold, but it is not the regulation 11 m.

The whole vignette is 3.5 s scaled (5 s real at the menu's 0.7 slow-mo) because the 1.6 s FistPump needs to play out after the ~1.5 s beat to the net; the task's '2-3 s' is met for the beat itself, not the hold.

Two Goalkeeper 'X8 dead constants' comments aside, nothing in Goalkeeper/Crosser/Celebration was touched; if Goalkeeper's DeadBand or reaction constants change, the scene's class-summary arithmetic must be re-run.
